label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

expected_schema.description: Services with rentable SMS numbers somewhere in the catalog. Each entry: the alias to pass as `service` in POST /rent, a display name, and the cheapest SKU price across all countries. Add ?country=<iso> to get the services offered in one country with live price and inventory pool. Companion route GET /countries lists countries (filter with ?service=<code>).

code.description: Service alias — pass verbatim as `service` in POST /rent (e.g. tg, wa, zo for OpenAI, other for any platform).

from_usdc.description: Cheapest SKU price for this service across countries (1, 2, or 5).

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
